blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Local broadcaster Adrian “Golden Boy” Loterte died in a hospital shortly after 5 p.m. on Monday, Oct. 12, after he was shot in Barangay San Roque, Daraga, Albay, prompting the town mayor and local media group to condemn the attack and demand a swift investigation. Loterte, an anchor for RBN News Television’s Rabas Cun Rabas and a resident of Barangay San Roque, was at his bakery in Purok 4 when one of two suspects allegedly fired multiple shots at him around 4:10 p.m., according to Bicol police spokesperson Lt.
